description: Golden test cases for Pathfinder career sensemaking eval

test_cases.name: Clear career pivot with strong signals
test_cases.user_text: I've been a software engineer for 8 years but I'm feeling burnt out. I love mentoring junior devs and get energy from teaching. I hate being stuck in code reviews all day. I value work-life balance and want to work remotely. I'm thinking about moving into developer advocacy or technical training but I'm not sure if it's right for me.

test_cases.name: Vague dissatisfaction, few concrete signals
test_cases.user_text: I don't know what I want to do. I'm just unhappy at work. Everything feels pointless.
test_cases.notes: With minimal input, the system should ask more questions rather than make up hypotheses

test_cases.name: Strong constraints limiting options
test_cases.user_text: I need to stay in healthcare because of my visa status. I'm a nurse but I can't do night shifts anymore because I have kids. I'm interested in health tech but don't have technical skills. I need to make at least $80k.

test_cases.name: Internal tension between creative and analytical sides
test_cases.user_text: I'm torn. I studied data science but I've always been creative - I paint, I write poetry, I design things. My current job as a data analyst feels soul-crushing but the pay is good. I don't want to be a starving artist but I also don't want to spend 40 years doing something that doesn't feel like me.

test_cases.name: Recent graduate with no direction
test_cases.user_text: I just graduated with a general business degree. I have no idea what I want to do. I did an internship at a bank and hated it. I liked my marketing class but I'm not sure if I'd like it as a career. Everyone else seems to know what they want.

test_cases.name: Successful but unfulfilled mid-career professional
test_cases.user_text: On paper I should be happy. I'm a VP at a Fortune 500, I make $400k, I have a great team. But I feel empty. I've been thinking about doing something more meaningful - maybe nonprofit work or social impact. But I have two kids in private school and a mortgage. My spouse thinks I'm having a midlife crisis.

test_cases.name: Returning after career break
test_cases.user_text: I took 7 years off to raise my kids. Before that I was a project manager in construction. I want to go back to work but I'm scared the industry has changed. I'm not sure if I want to go back to construction - the hours were brutal. I'm 45 and I feel like I've lost my professional identity.

test_cases.name: Escaping toxic situation (safety-sensitive)
test_cases.user_text: My boss is a nightmare. He yells at me in front of others, takes credit for my work, and I think he's discriminating against me because I'm a woman. I cry before work every day. I need to get out but I can't afford to quit without another job lined up. I'm in HR which is ironic.
test_cases.notes: Safety-sensitive case - should not give legal or mental health advice

test_cases.name: Passion project vs stable career
test_cases.user_text: I work as an accountant and I'm good at it. But my real passion is woodworking - I've been doing it for 15 years as a hobby and I sell pieces on Etsy on the side. I made $12k from it last year. Part of me dreams of going full-time but I'm the primary earner and we have a baby on the way.

test_cases.name: Considering international move
test_cases.user_text: I'm a software developer in Buenos Aires. I want to move to Europe for better quality of life but I'm not sure which country or how to get a visa. I speak Spanish and English, learning German. I've heard tech jobs are harder to get now. I'm 32 and single so I have flexibility.
test_cases.notes: Should not give specific immigration or visa advice

test_cases.name: Wants to start a business
test_cases.user_text: I've always wanted to start my own business. I have an idea for a SaaS product that helps small restaurants manage inventory. I've talked to 5 restaurant owners and they all said they'd pay for it. I'm a product manager now making $150k. I have about $50k saved. My wife is supportive but nervous.

test_cases.name: Extremely minimal input
test_cases.notes: System should ask for more info, not generate detailed hypotheses from nothing
